name: interferon gamma receptor 1

function.text: IFNGR1 encodes interferon gamma receptor 1. Annotated molecular activities include cytokine receptor activity and type II interferon receptor activity. It participates in signal transduction and astrocyte activation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to autosomal dominant mendelian susceptibility to mycobacterial diseases due to partial IFNgammaR1 deficiency (autosomal dominant); immunodeficiency 27A (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
